text: Yes, deforestation occurred on this asset in 2023. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset detected a 0.7-hectare loss of tree cover, which is 1.2% of the asset. The JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 data confirms this area was forested in 2020, meeting the corroboration rule. The local forest map (MGAP 2021) indicates the lost area was planted forest (Eucalyptus spp.), not native forest. While 0.4 hectares of loss occurred in small patches (under 0.5 ha) and was not counted as an event, the remaining 0.3 hectares still qualify as deforestation under the analysis parameters.
